property_summary: For every ERC-165 interface id that C claims (IERC165, IERC1155, IERC1155MetadataURI, indexed by a fuzzed selector), C.supportsInterface must return true; the mutant drops the IERC1155 check so it returns false for the core ERC-1155 interface id.
change_summary: Remove the IERC1155 interfaceId check so supportsInterface no longer reports the core ERC1155 interface.
